## Bug fixes

- An explicitly requested governance update can now hand off the owning chat's idle runtime reservation and restore it after installation. Other active work still blocks the update.
- Interrupted updates retain their staged candidate and original operation. Cancellation before activation restores the prior reservation and respects a session that has already closed.

## Adoption

Use the packaged install guidance for `update --handoff-startup`. An older installation can use the verified unpacked 4.4.1 updater with its retained request, plan and operation directory. This does not change the requested target version or require restarting Codex.

Installation and task-policy adoption remain deliberate. Publishing this release does not upgrade existing worktrees.

## Qualification

Qualified through the normal local 4.x release process: integrated source checks, installed archive proof, focused recovery regressions and packaged update scenarios. These synthetic checks do not establish physical-device or ordinary development acceptance.
